reuse.why: Fintegra linking goes through the existing linkBankSyncAccount and findOrCreateBank and follows the providers' download pattern, but the takeover copies unlinkAccount's field reset instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: The eight-field unlink reset repeats unlinkAccount, downloadFintegraTransactions copies the Akahu download body, the same ensure call is pasted into six provider wrappers, and index.ts exports './fintegra' twice.

placement.why: The link rules sit in a helper in accounts/app.ts, but it is called from each provider wrapper instead of from linkBankSyncAccount, the one path every link already shares.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps (provider, rules, flag, types), with a duplicated export line and a stray blank-line removal in a test as noise.

maintainability.why: A future provider must remember to call ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked itself, and a helper named 'ensure not linked' that also checks closed accounts and unlinks others is surprising.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every provider link calls ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked and linkBankSyncAccount; the unlink reset is copied rather than bypassing a shared local-unlink helper (none exists).

disguised_duplication.where: The copied unlink reset and Fintegra download are literal copies, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked gained a replaceExistingLink flag plus a closed-account branch and a mutate-on-replace branch; the shared linkBankSyncAccount was left untouched while six wrappers each call the check.
